services.name: The Sails
services.desc: Head out from Loon’s Foot Landing and hoist the sails for a 2 ½ hour excursion. The current conditions will determine the route; either we’ll set a course for the Big Lake or stay within the protected waters of the Duluth/Superior Harbor. Feel free to bring beverages and snacks with you, but we do ask that you leave your pets at home. Passenger Minimum: We have a required minimum of 3 passengers to sail. If we don’t meet that minimum requirement and your party of 2 or fewer still wants to sail we will accommodate that for an additional fee to bring your total to $255 plus tax and booking fees. blurb: Guests sail Duluth, MN and Superior, WI from the water aboard a 60 foot steel schooner named Charley. Depending on weather, sails go on Lake Superior or down the harbor. Sails operate Fridays and Saturdays out of Loon’s Foot Marine in Superior, WI.
